candidate_claim_cn: 世界模型可以保持预测分布完全不变，却把基于反向传播的规划推向错误方向。
operation: Y_native(a)=a+0.1 Phi^{-1}(U); Y_shift(a)=a+0.1 Phi^{-1}((U-10a) mod 1), U fresh Uniform(0,1). Both are exactly N(a,0.01) for every action. Independent fresh U per candidate/query/step preserves the whole conditional joint forward law, not merely single-candidate marginals.
theory_boundary: Off the wrap boundaries, dY_shift/da = 1 - 1/phi(Phi^{-1}((U-10a) mod 1)) <= 1-sqrt(2pi)<0. The omitted moving-boundary contribution invalidates exchanging expectation and pathwise differentiation.
permissions: Control of the differentiable sampler implementation; not input-only or checkpoint-weights-only poisoning. Uses genuine autodiff through the forward program, not a forged custom backward.
novelty_boundary: Known moving-boundary/pathwise-gradient bias, existing prediction-preserving gradient-manipulation work, and extra sampler-source permissions leave no demonstrated distinct world-model security contribution. This is a research decision, not proof that every related attack is impossible.
report_note_cn: 本轮未通过原生控制任务的干净基线门槛：冻结的高斯动力学组件配合研究用梯度 MPC，在完整 DMControl cartpole-balance 回合中仅得364.32/1000，低于预设900分；因此攻击与修正组均未运行。MBDPO 源码另确认使用确定性动力学及无梯度规划，当前采样梯度构造不适用。该构造依赖修改采样源码，且移动边界梯度偏差与输出/梯度分离已有先行工作；保留解析反例，但停止将它扩展为论文主贡献。此结果不否定一般可能性，也不构成攻击成功或已达7–7.5新意目标的证据。

closest_priors.title: Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?
closest_priors.finding: Exact simulation gradients can be biased under discontinuities; stiff smooth approximations can have finite-sample empirical bias. Generic truthful-forward/wrong-gradient control failure is established.

closest_priors.title: Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Scalable Composite Policy Gradient Estimators
closest_priors.finding: TPX combines likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradients in Dreamer; correct-gradient alternatives and gradient variance control are existing baselines.

closest_priors.title: Gradient-based Analysis of NLP Models is Manipulable
closest_priors.finding: Prediction-preserving manipulation of input gradients is prior security work; a new downstream use does not by itself establish novelty.

closest_priors.title: Does "Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?" Give Better Policy Gradients?
closest_priors.finding: Current work revisits estimator switching and variance control; abstract inspected, not reproduced.

next_requirement: Find a substantively different security operation with an explicit edit and an applicable competent native controller before another experiment; no additional toy quantile witnesses, weak-control tuning, or scale-up of this fixed source-level gradient construction.

controller_gate.planner: Researcher-defined projected Adam MPC on a frozen DMO StochSSM component.

decision: Retain the mathematical counterexample but stop expanding this fixed sampler-source construction as the main novelty candidate. Do not train around the failed clean MPC gate. Reopening requires a substantively distinct threat operation or contribution, a competent existing applicable controller, and causal task-level evidence.

external_review.status: Critique agrees current novelty case is insufficient; no accepted alternative proposed. This opinion is not independent experimental evidence or a novelty certificate.
external_review.rejected_suggestion: Its suggestion to install the Gaussian sampler operation in TD-MPC2 is inapplicable to deterministic native dynamics. Forward-law equality gives equality in distribution of forward-only decisions, not equal trajectories under the same numeric RNG seed after a reparameterization.
